aliases: サンスベリア・トリファスキアタ

light.best.quote: Place in a location where it will receive direct sunlight only part of the day, 2 to 6 hours

light.min.quote: as it will tolerate very low light

light.directSun.quote: Place in a location where it will receive direct sunlight only part of the day, 2 to 6 hours

temperature.minC.quote: It tolerates low humidity and cool temperatures around 50 degrees.

temperature.idealC.reason: 出典に数値の記載がないため、熱帯原産の観葉植物が成長する一般的な室温の範囲とした

watering.growing.quote: In spring to autumn allow the soil to dry between waterings.

watering.winter.quote: In winter only water every one to two months.

tips.ja: 水はけのよい土と控えめな水やりが必須。水のやりすぎで根が腐る。
tips.quote: Well-drained soil and careful watering are a must; do not overwater, as the roots will rot.

note: 以前は Sansevieria trifasciata という学名だったが、現在はドラセナ属に分類されている。
